title: SAE-MOGWO-PRS: A probability ranking strategy-based grey wolf optimizer for spatio-temporal adaptive collaborative logistics network optimization
content:
by Yitong Liu, Tianyu Li, Hong Zhang

The spatio-Temporal adaptive collaborative logistics network optimization problems investigated in this paper involve multiple objectives. Most evolutionary multi-objective optimization algorithms, however, do not account for the heterogeneity in evaluation times. Instead, they perform high-fidelity evaluations on all objectives for promising population positions identified by their associated surrogate-assisted optimization algorithms in the solution space. While this approach provides complete and error-free solution evaluations, it does not yield the most computationally efficient procedure. To address this limitation, we propose a novel Surrogate-assisted Evolutionary Multi-objective Grey Wolf Optimizer with Probabilistic Ranking Strategy (SAE-MOGWO-PRS). This algorithm is designed to determine which individuals and objective functions within the population should undergo high-fidelity evaluation, thereby enhancing their ability to generate non-dominated solutions with improved convergence and diversity in the Multi-objective Grey Wolf Optimizer. To validate the efficacy of the proposed SAE-MOGWO-PRS algorithm, we compared it against four state-of-the-art surrogate-assisted multi-objective optimization algorithms, including those that specifically handle heterogeneous evaluation times. The comparative analysis on four test problems demonstrates the superior performance of the proposed probabilistic ranking strategy-based algorithm, thereby confirming the effectiveness of the SAE-MOGWO-PRS method.
